item.title: ‘Believers from all over the world’ take hope of Jesus to Winter Olympics
item.description: Southern Baptists are ready to share the hope of Christ with the nations! As the 2026 Winter Olympic games get under way, International Mission Board missionaries from all over Italy are teaming up with hundreds of U.S. volunteers.

item.title: Mob assaults pastor over Christian conversions
item.description: A mob assaulted a pastor in India reportedly because some individuals in his church had converted to Christianity.

item.title: Spring convocation encourages Christ-centered athletics at UM
item.description: For student athletes at the University of Mobile, the most important victories aren’t decided on a field or court, but in the foundation on which they build their lives – a foundation grounded in Christ.

item.title: Pleasant View Missionary Baptist in Holly Pond hosting singing Feb. 15
item.description: Pleasant View Missionary Baptist Church, Holly Pond, will host a singing Feb. 15 at 5 p.m. featuring New Ground from Scottsboro.

item.title: First Baptist Church Hoover hosting Alabama Singing Men on Feb. 19
item.description: First Baptist Church Hoover will host the Alabama Singing Men in concert Feb. 19 at 1:30 p.m.

item.title: International partnership with Christian Academy of Guatemala announced at UM
item.description: The University of Mobile has established a new international dual enrollment partnership with Christian Academy of Guatemala, expanding UM’s global academic footprint.

item.title: Ambush kills pastor, two family members; grandchild left to die
item.description: A pastor and two family members were slain and his infant grandchild sustained a serious machete wound when extremists ambushed the family Jan. 16.

item.title: Congressional hearing highlights state’s reading success
item.description: Alabama’s efforts to improve literacy were on full display on Capitol Hill on Feb. 10 as Bonnie Short of the Alabama Reading Initiative detailed to House appropriators how the state’s efforts have helped students become better readers.
